posts.title: is there any way you would sell utena playing cards again?
posts.description: There is, in fact! I had made them in bulk to ship from me back in the day, but the place I had them printed did offer one-off printing should people want that! Given it has been almost a decade though , I sent a test print to them just to make sure everything's still good with the design. I'll follow up with you all here!
